summary: Iter 8 (exit-rule whipsaw fix, win_rate, Solana Fund Wallet Guide). Backend: new tests/test_iteration8_exit_rules.py 11/11 pass, and the iteration 6+7 regression suites pass (46/46 total, -n 0). engine.signal() was tested with a synthetic SNAPSHOT (40 candles falling or rising): (a) losing -0.3% with SMA7<SMA25 -> SELL 'cutting early'; losing with SMA7>SMA25 -> HOLD 'in position'; (b) winning +0.3% with SMA7<SMA25 -> HOLD 'winner rides' (no sell); RSI 80 while winning -> HOLD (RSI>75 no longer exits); (c) entry 2% above -> SELL 'STOP LOSS'; (d) +1.6% with tp_taken False and partial_tp True -> SELL partial 'PARTIAL TAKE PROFIT'; (e) tp_taken True, peak 2% above, trailing on -> SELL 'TRAILING STOP'. win_rate checked through the API: 0 with no trades, 2/5 -> 40, 2/3 -> 67. /api/bot/config still saves take_profit_pct, stop_loss_pct, trailing_stop, partial_tp, trend_filter and volume_filter. Frontend (fresh user with an imported generated wallet, 1920 and 390): solana-fund-guide is present; the toggle shows a QR <svg>; solana-fund-address equals the full pubkey and matches the short solana-pubkey; copy shows the 'Address copied' toast; SAINDRA and Dacity cards are present; no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth equals innerWidth at both sizes); the WIN RATE card shows '0%'; the footer text matches exactly. Admin login works through the API. The admin bot and real users' bots were not touched.

minor.issue: Floating-point edge: when the price is exactly +tp% above entry, move can be 1.49999 and fail `move >= tp`, so TP fires one tick late. This is harmless in practice. A small epsilon (move >= tp - 1e-9) would fix it.

Losing positions are still cut on any SMA7<SMA25 cross, even at -0.01%. Fees/spread make each such cut a loss, so win_rate can still drift down in choppy markets. Consider a minimum loss threshold (e.g. move < -0.3%) before cutting early.
pnl is rounded to 4 dp, but realized_pnl is still rounded to 2 dp. Tiny $1 trades add up to drift in REALIZED. The UI streak card shows +$0.00 for small gains.

issues: The full address wraps onto 2 lines at both 1920 and 390. This is readable but the copy icon is the only easy way to use it. Fine as is.

action_items: Optional: add an epsilon to the TP comparison in engine.signal
Optional: add a minimum loss threshold before the SMA-cross early cut, to reduce fee-driven small losses
Optional: store realized_pnl with 4 dp to match the per-trade pnl precision

Lines 99-104: move is computed twice. A small refactor would help, not a bug
